uniteDbPokemon.notes: Batch-01 mechanics survey used descriptions, true_desc, notes, buffs, cooldowns, levels, and formulas from this public JSON.

passiveEffects.name: Aroma Veil
passiveEffects.originalDescription: When an ally is under the effect of one of Alcremie's shields or buffs, remove any hindrances that are applied or are currently affecting that ally. This ability will go on cooldown for 10s after removing a hindrance. This ability can also work on Alcremie as well. When Milcery evolves into Alcremie, gain a Sweet Gauge. When the Sweet Gauge is filled at 15 stacks, the cooldown of one charge of Recover and Decorate will be reset. These moves will also be empowered.

moveEffects.name: Charm
moveEffects.originalDescription: Charm a target Pokémon with your cute voice, dealing damage to the first Pokémon hit. Pokémon hit by the charm have their Attack reduced by 30 and Special Attack reduced by 20 and movement speed reduced by 30% for 2s. Additionally, increases the sweet gauge by 2.

uniteMoveEffects.name: Fluffy Cream Supreme
uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: Create a giant cake and stand atop it becoming unstoppable and gaining a shield for 6s. Then throw whipped cream at allies. Allies who receive whipped cream are healed and have their maximum HP buffed for 8s. This move ends early if this move's shield is lost, Alcremie becomes bound, or if the move is manually cancelled. The shield is 60% of Alcremie's max HP Unite buffs: 40% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 30% Max HP Shield (Applied when the move ends)
